description.zh:
基线问题是否已处理。取值：

- **Y**：已处理
- **N**：未处理
description.en:
Specifies whether the baseline risks are handled. Valid values:

*   **Y**: yes
*   **N**: no

description.zh: 导出任务的类型。固定取值为**hc\_check_warning**，表示导出基线检查结果。
description.en: The type of the export task. Set the value to **hc_check_warning**, which indicates tasks to export baseline check results.

description.zh:
服务器的分组ID。
> 您可调用[DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~)接口获取服务器的分组ID。
description.en:
The ID of the server group.

>  You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to query the IDs of server groups.

description.zh:
弱口令基线检查结果的导出方式。取值：

- **0**：弱口令进行脱敏后导出
- **1**：弱口令直接明文导出
description.en:
The export method of the results for the weak password baseline check. Valid values:

*   **0**: exports the check results after it is masked.
*   **1**: exports the check results in plaintext.

description.zh:
基线检查结果是否汇总导出。取值：

- **0**：否
- **1**：是
description.en:
Specifies whether the baseline check results are aggregated and exported. Valid values:

*   **0**: no
*   **1**: yes

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

description.zh: 基线检查结果的风险项ID。多个风险项ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The ID of the risk item in the baseline check results. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
基线的风险等级。多个风险等级之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

- **high**：高危
- **medium**：中危
- **low**：低危
description.en:
The severity of the baseline check item. Separate multiple severities with commas (,). Valid values:

*   **high**
*   **medium**
*   **low**
The source IP address of the request.

description.zh:
基线检查结果的风险项的状态。多个状态值之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

- **3**：已通过
- **1**：未通过
description.en:
The status of the check item in the baseline check results. Separate multiple statuses with commas (,). Valid values:

*   **3**: passed
*   **1**: failed
The ID of the baseline check policy.

description.zh:
设置要导出的基线检查结果所属的基线子类型。多个子类型之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> 调用[DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~)接口返回的**SubTypes**字段下的**TypeName**字段。
description.en:
The subtypes of the baselines based on which baseline checks are performed. Separate multiple subtypes with commas (,).

> You must set the value of this parameter to the value of the **TypeName** parameter that is contained in the **SubTypes** parameter. You can call the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation to obtain the value of the TypeName parameter.

description.zh:
设置要导出的基线检查结果所属的基线类型。
> 调用[DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~)接口返回的**TypeName**字段。**TypeName**、**TypeNames**这两个参数同时设置时，仅**TypeName**生效。
description.en:
The type of the baseline based on which baseline checks are performed.

> You must set the value of this parameter to the value of the **TypeName** parameter that is returned by calling the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation. If both the **TypeName** and **TypeNames** parameters are specified, only the **TypeName** parameter takes effect.

description.zh:
设置要导出的基线检查结果所属的基线类型。多个类型之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> 调用[DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~)接口返回的**TypeName**字段。**TypeName**、**TypeNames**这两个参数同时设置时，仅**TypeName**生效。
description.en:
The types of the baselines based on which baseline checks are performed. Separate multiple types with commas (,).

> You must set the value of this parameter to the value of the **TypeName** parameter that is returned by calling the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation. If both the **TypeName** and **TypeNames** parameters are specified, only the **TypeName** parameter takes effect.

description.zh: 要导出基线检查结果列表的服务器资产的UUID。多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The UUID of the server whose baseline check results you want to export. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas export-warning --source-ip 192.0.XX.XX --lang zh --uuids inet-7c676676-06fa-442e-90fb-b802e0000,inet-7c676676-06fa-442e-90fb-b0000 --type-name hc_container --type-names hc_container,cis --sub-type-names hc_middleware_ack_master --risk-levels high,medium --status-list 1,3 --risk-name Alibaba_Cloud_Standard_-_Windows_2016/2019_Security_Baseline --dealed N --is-summary-export 1 --strategy-id 12 --risk-ids 123,124 --export-type hc_check_warning --is-cleartext-pwd 0 --group-id 13007754 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ExportWarning --region cn-hangzhou --TypeNames 'hc_container,cis' --TypeName hc_container --SubTypeNames hc_middleware_ack_master --StatusList '1,3' --IsSummaryExport 1 --ExportType hc_check_warning --StrategyId 12 --Lang zh --Dealed N --RiskLevels 'high,medium' --RiskName 'Alibaba_Cloud_Standard_-_Windows_2016/2019_Security_Baseline' --GroupId 13007754 --IsCleartextPwd 0 --SourceIp '192.0.XX.XX' --RiskIds '123,124' --Uuids 'inet-7c676676-06fa-442e-90fb-b802e0000,inet-7c676676-06fa-442e-90fb-b0000'
